scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
real_provider_requirement: Use exact existing page_helpers::Page and both actual exported predicates. Do not recreate private Page or substitute offset layout; actual Page predicates read mode/count volatile.
strict_cases: NULL Page with NULL/present memobj and every held memobj flag, preserving OR semantics
nonNULL Page with each PM mode and count at INT_MIN,-1,0,1,2,INT_MAX
private/shared, PF_PATCH on/off, write/read-only cross-product, including irrelevant high bits
observe first predicate then only conditionally second predicate even for non-private/non-patch ranges; snapshot all range/memobj/Page bytes; no mutation/ref/free/lock changes
checks: actual real-header signatures, reason64 and mode/count sign
unique actual helper/provider definitions and real default C caller relocation; exact bytes/all allocated relocations object to partial
original C fallback preprocessor and exact source statements retained
